title: Restaurant Competitor Menu & Price Monitor input
description: Paste public restaurant homepages or menu URLs. The Actor discovers same-site menu pages, creates a baseline, and emits only matched changes.

restaurantUrls.title: Restaurant menu URLs
restaurantUrls.description: Restaurant homepages or exact menu URLs. Same-site menu links are discovered automatically.

monitorKey.title: Monitor key
monitorKey.description: Stable key for this watchlist. Reuse it on scheduled runs to compare against the same baseline.

currencyFallback.title: Fallback currency
currencyFallback.description: Three-letter ISO currency code used when a menu price has no explicit currency.

emitBaseline.title: Emit baseline menu items
emitBaseline.description: When enabled, the first run emits BASELINE_ITEM rows. The baseline is always stored.

emitFullSnapshot.title: Emit complete menu snapshots
emitFullSnapshot.description: Also write every normalized menu item on every run. Leave off for change-only monitoring.

maxPagesPerRestaurant.title: Pages per restaurant
maxPagesPerRestaurant.description: Maximum same-site pages fetched while discovering the menu.

minimumPriceChangePercent.title: Minimum price movement
minimumPriceChangePercent.description: Suppress smaller price changes from the output and webhook. Other event types are unaffected.

keywords.title: Dish/category keywords
keywords.description: Optional watchlist such as burger, chicken, lunch, or vegan. Empty means all items.

eventTypes.title: Change types
eventTypes.description: Optional event allowlist. Empty means every change type.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives one run summary plus all changes.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each public restaurant page request.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of restaurant websites checked at the same time.
